name: Azure Touch
description: Lay a pale blue frost on the target's arm with an open hand.

name: Sky Rime
description: Spread a clear glaze of rime above the head to turn a falling blow.

name: Reserve Breath
description: Draw one long cold breath and hold it as a level reserve in the chest.

name: Twin Glaze
description: Glaze the floor in two crossing lines to catch both of an opponent's feet.

name: Blue Edge
description: Cut with a blue-edged hand that slices through cloth and the muscle below it.

name: Hush Salve
description: Steady an ally's torn arm with cold hands and let the cold close the wound edge.

name: Sky Spear
description: Drive a long spear of ice from a high guard through shield and armour.

name: Azure Hold
description: Close broad bands of pale ice about an opponent's chest and arms and tighten them slowly.

name: Rime Crown
description: Bring a crown of ice down in a ring round the user that freezes everything within reach.

name: Skyfrost Verdict
description: School move: lay the whole blue frost of the course on one opponent in a single open-handed blow that stills the body and breaks the guard.

name: Pair Rime
description: Lay rime in matched strips on both forearms to prepare for paired work.

name: Rime Cross
description: Cross both rimed forearms against the target's chest and bear down.

name: Cover Pair
description: Parry a blow with one rimed arm and cover the opening with the other.

name: Pair Lash
description: Lash one ice cord at the arm and one at the leg in the same cast.

name: Mirrored Ward
description: Form two sheets of ice at angles to each other that catch and trap a blow between them.

name: Rime Pairing
description: Chain a strike from the left hand with a binding from the right in one flowing motion.

name: Cold Cleanse
description: Place a cold hand on either side of an ally's tainted wound and press the taint out between them.

name: Crossing Rime
description: Send two sheets of rime across a wide space so that they cross at the centre of a group.

name: Locked Pair
description: Press a rimed palm to each of an opponent's shoulders and freeze both arm channels.

name: Mirror Frost
description: Hold two facing planes of ice that throw a qi attack between them and return it to its caster.

name: Twinbound Frost
description: School move: bind one opponent with two matched frozen holds at once so every limb is stilled and the guard lies open to a single sure blow.

name: Pair Chill
description: Spread a ring of cold round the user and the nearest ally and read all who cross it.

name: Pair Frost
description: Strike alongside an ally so that two cold blows land in the same count.

name: Shared Guard
description: Cover an ally's flank with the same frost that covers the user's own.

name: Even Step
description: Move in step with an ally across a shared patch of glazed ground.

name: Linked Bind
description: Close ice between the user and an ally so the opponent standing between them cannot cross.

name: Joint Hail
description: Throw hail together with an ally so that two sheets strike one target at once.

name: Mutual Mend
description: Pass a cold healing hand over hand between two wounded allies to ease both together.

name: Linked Purge
description: Draw a cleansing chill through two linked hands to carry a toxin out of one ally and dissolve it.

name: Linked Ward
description: Link wards of ice between the user and allies so that a blow on one is shared by all.

name: Joint Lance
description: Cast a lance together with an ally that pierces where one alone would be turned aside.

name: Twin Zero
description: Spread a ring of absolute cold round two cultivators standing together so foes who enter it slow to a halt.

name: Twinfrost Accord
description: School move: two cultivators lay their frost into one shared seal that stills a foe and shields both of them.

name: Core Chill
description: Draw cold up from the formed core and hold it at the palms.

name: Zero Palm
description: Lay a palm charged from the core on the target and let the cold go.

name: Core Rime
description: Wrap the body in a layer of cold drawn from the core.

name: Twin Draw
description: Draw cold from the core down both tracks at once for a stronger next strike.

name: Zero Bind
description: Hold an opponent in cold from both palms until every limb is fixed.

name: Core Mend
description: Pass cold from the core into an ally's wound to close it and still the pain.

name: Deep Zero
description: Drive cold from the core through the palm into the target's centre so that all motion slows.

name: Core Fracture
description: Strike a frozen limb with a core-driven blow so that the stiffened guard breaks apart.

name: Zero Reign
description: Spread the formed core's cold in a wide field in which every living body slows and every moving thing falls.

name: Dual Zero
description: School move: strike with both tracks of core cold at once so the body and the qi of the target are stilled together.

name: Wind Oath
description: Swear a short oath to the wind that the cold in the hand will not waver.

name: Draft Frost
description: Throw frost on a cold draught into the eyes of the target.

name: Sworn Hoar
description: Hold a ward of sworn ice against a single blow.

name: Oath Rime
description: Bind a limb with rime sworn to hold until the word that sets it free.

name: Bitter Hold
description: Hold a bitter freezing wind about an opponent's torso until the breathing shortens.

name: Gentle Rime
description: Ease an ally's wound with a gentle breath of cold that numbs and closes it.

name: Sworn Purge
description: Swear to purge a taint from an ally and draw it out with a thin steady cold.

name: Gale Rime
description: Whip a sworn gale of rime across the field in front of the user.

name: Sworn Lock
description: Close a frozen seal on an opponent's stance and hold it with the oath.

name: Oath Zero
description: Swear the cold over the field and press it down on all who stand against the oath.

name: Frostsworn Gale
description: School move: send the oath-bound gale of frost across every opposing hand and leave them sworn to stillness.

name: Bound Rime
description: Lay a rime on the palm and bind it by a word so that it holds its shape.

name: Sworn Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a sworn cold into the target.

name: Sworn Glaze
description: Turn a blow aside with a sheet of ice raised at a spoken vow.

name: Rime Vow
description: Swear that the cold will stay until released and press it onto the target's chest.

name: Bound Edge
description: Cut with an edge of ice bound by oath not to melt until the cut has landed.

name: Vow Mend
description: Swear to keep an ally from the edge and hold the wound closed with a steady cold.

name: Vow Lance
description: Cast a lance of ice at the end of a spoken vow so that it pierces what the vow names.

name: Bound Frost
description: Freeze the ground in a circle by oath and hold every foot in it until the word is lifted.

name: Vow Zero
description: Speak the vow of stillness and let the cold cancel one qi art and slow its caster.

name: Oathbound Frost
description: School move: seal a foe's stance and strike once within the span of one spoken oath so the hold ends only when the word ends.

name: Ice Stride
description: Cross a long gap in one stride along a lane of ice cast ahead of the foot.

name: Falling Rime
description: Strike downward from a long step with rime on the open hand.

name: Broad Ward
description: Hold a broad flat plate of ice across the front to take a long sweep.

name: Far Chill
description: Cast a thin chill far across the ground and read what disturbs it.

name: Reaching Lance
description: Throw a lance of ice a great distance in a flat straight line.

name: Stride Bind
description: Freeze the ground ahead of a charging opponent so the next stride sticks.

name: Open Mend
description: Cool an ally's wound with a long steady stream of cold from some paces away.

name: Clear Chill
description: Send a clean thin chill into an ally to still a poison and let the body expel it.

name: Plunging Lance
description: Leap and hurl a lance of ice down at a steep angle through guard and ground alike.

name: Far Hold
description: Hold a distant opponent in a long cord of ice cast across open ground.

name: Long Zero
description: Send a wave of near absolute cold along a wide front so every body it crosses slows.

name: Boundless Cold
description: School move: cast one unbroken line of cold across the whole open ground so everything standing on it is pierced and slowed.

name: Bare Core
description: Draw cold from the formed core and leave it open at the palms in plain air.

name: Bare Zero
description: Strike with a bare hand charged with the plain cold of the core.

name: Bare Rime
description: Hold a ward of thin clear ice in the open with nothing built behind it.

name: Core Gale
description: Throw a gale of core cold round a group in the open air.

name: Unwalled Ward
description: Hold cold in open air with no frame about it so that it turns blows from every side.

name: Still Mend
description: Hold a hand of core cold over an ally's wound until it closes and the pain falls away.

name: Core Purge
description: Send core cold through an ally to freeze a taint into a solid mass and draw it out.

name: Open Lance
description: Cast a lance of core cold in plain view along the open line to the target.

name: Wide Bind
description: Freeze every foot in a wide stretch of open ground to the earth beneath it.

name: Unwalled Zero
description: Open the core's cold across the field with no wall to hold it and let it slow everything in sight.

name: Sovereign Chill
description: School move: lay the open cold of the core across the whole field so that no foe in it can move or call qi.
